The cascade's tails, made solid.
- 100 mB Depleted Uranium Hexafluoride + 100 mB Hydrogen + 100 mB Steam in the Chemical Reactor gives Depleted Uranium Dust and 200 mB Hydrofluoric Acid back.
- Smelt the dust into ingots, and nine ingots into a block.
A Block of Depleted Uranium lets only 5% of radiation through, the best shield there is, though it's a little radioactive itself. Its ingots can stand in for lead in shielding recipes.
